Claire: Quick heads-up — found divergence after int8 quant on the new lgi-3b variant when priming with a long document (~60k tokens). Matches baseline until ~12k tokens then drifts; KV-cache shows repeated index collisions.
Ravi: can you paste a minimal repro? deterministic on seed?
Claire: repro steps below, deterministic on our runner.
```
python repro.py --model lgi-3b-int8 --prompt long_seed.txt --max_new_tokens 512
```
Cache check shows duplicate keys at positions 12288 and 4096 (looks like wrap). Suspect RoPE scaling mismatch under quantization + compact tiling.
Marta: did you try turning off rotary scaling or running fp16?
Claire: fp16 baseline is clean. Disabling rotary_decay in runtime also fixes it. Problem only when int8 + prefix prepending (we prepend an 8k token audio transcript).
Ravi: can you dump KV shapes and dtypes for the failing layer? Also copy the small log where you detect collision.
Claire: KV dump snippet: 
- layer5: keys shape (12, 64, 4096), dtype=int8
- layer5 baseline: (12, 64, 4096), dtype=float16
Log: "kv_index_collision: found existing entry at idx=4096 for token_pos=12288"
Also observed negative wrap in rotary phase for positions >16384 (phase mod mismatch).
Marta: assigning eng-runtime to triage, pinging @Alex to take a look.
Alex: taking it. Quick Q: what's the exact prompt segmentation — any overlapping priming windows?
Claire: we stream as prefix (8192 tokens) + incremental chunks. We keep an overlap of 256 tokens between chunks to avoid boundary artifacts.
Alex: hypothesis: quantized KVs + compact tiling + our index arithmetic produce a modulo that collides when token_pos exceeds tile boundary (e.g., 4096 or 12288). I'll run an isolated kernel repro toggling tile_size and pack_bits.
Ravi: also add this to longcontext regression suite (longctx-v2) and mark a quality-alert if token-level divergence >1% on our eval prompt set.
Claire: adding CI job now; pushing a smoke run to staging.
